title: Three-dimensional Analysis of the Lattice Bending Strain by Iterative Phase Retrieval of Electron Rocking Curves
content: Lattice strains in crystals significantly affect various physical properties of crystal materials, such as mechanical properties, electrical conductivity, and magnetism. A method to reconstruct the z-dependence lattice displacement field by the phase retrieval of electron rocking curves was proposed by Vincent [1].
